description: Disable one agent of your principal permanently. Use it when an agent is unknown, compromised or no longer needed; it frees its slot. After this it can no longer authenticate (AGENT_REVOKED) and no longer holds a slot under max_agents_per_principal. Needs your agent credentials and the principal_key (argument or X-Principal-Key header). Its orders stay visible to the principal's other agents. Repeating it changes nothing (already_revoked).

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

principal_key.description: The principal's current principal_key (or X-Principal-Key header)

target_agent_id.description: agent_id of the agent to revoke; list_agents shows them

name: revoke_agent
title: Revoke an agent
